derivation: Task-semantic classification from the benchmark turns and system contract; independently drafted without campaign artifacts.

families.label: Grounded information / reference resolution
families.rationale: Direct event-knowledge answers, including conversational reference resolution.

families.label: Recommendation protocol / personalized synthesis
families.rationale: The dedicated multi-step contract to elicit interests and availability, recommend two sessions, and revise after correction.

families.label: Tool preparation / slot elicitation / disambiguation
families.rationale: An actionable workflow is active, but the assistant must collect or disambiguate information before acting.

families.label: Nonterminal tool commitment / confirmation
families.rationale: The gold response requires a concrete nonterminal function call with exact arguments, often assembled across turns.

families.label: Interaction boundary / closing pragmatics
families.rationale: The assistant must enforce its information boundary or recognize and execute the terminal user signal.

ambiguities.note: These turns combine adjacent semantic roles; assignments were frozen before family-level effects were computed.
